fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) stock rose 26.1% over the past 12 months, but investors have entered a slowdown phase as management signaled fiscal Q2 2027 as the low point for 2027 growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Fiscal year 2027 renewal cost incentives increased 21% year-over-year, and renewal-eligible revenue expanded from 20% to 25%, positioning as a headwind to 2027 profitability.
fields.summary_ko.2: Value-added service revenue is expected to grow in the low-to-mid 20% range for 2027, up from $14 billion out of $30 billion in 2026, maintaining significantly higher growth than overall low-to-mid single-digit growth guidance.
